relevance_note: Case report of one man with ABCA1 variants: "DNA sequencing revealed 3 heterozygous variants in the ABCA1 gene".
method_note: Hand extraction; a short script only assembled the JSON (no table transcribed by script). Single unnamed patient labelled 'patient' (rule 5). Father and brother included as relatives described in relation to the patient for their coronary procedures (CABG, PCI); they were not tested and their ABCA1 status is unknown; checklist 'coronary artery disease' marked observed for them from CABG/PCI. Patient's coronary artery disease marked observed from progressive coronary calcified plaque (Agatston 336, 99th percentile) and 'prevent progression of coronary atherosclerosis', although he 'has no symptoms of obstructive atherosclerotic disease'. Tonsils: 'did not have yellow or orange discoloration' recorded as an excluded feature, but checklist 'orange-colored or enlarged tonsils' left not reported because enlargement is not addressed (narrow vs broad rule). Bilateral corneal arcus recorded as a feature; checklist 'corneal opacity' left not reported (arcus not called an opacity by the paper). 'The liver and spleen size were normal' recorded as excluded hepatomegaly and splenomegaly (D-27). Lipid values (LDL-C, TG) are on treatment and not described as low or high, so low LDL and hypertriglyceridemia left not reported; Lp(a), small dense LDL-C and hs-CRP given with thresholds but not called normal, so not recorded. Table 1 (dates as columns) and Table 2 are lab tables for the one patient; HDL-C 4 mg/dL in text vs 2.0 mg/dL in Table 2 are different samples. Contradictions: p.G592G frameshift X37 is called 'The frameshift variant' and 'a likely pathogenic nonsense mutation' (type recorded as frameshift), and 'likely pathogenic' in Investigation but '1 ABCA1 pathogenic mutation' in Discussion (recorded 'likely pathogenic'). Diagnosis: 'consistent with severe ABCA1 deficiency, but not Tangier disease' vs 'highly suggestive of Tangier disease but not definitive'. Phase of the 3 variants 'could not be determined'; zygosity recorded as heterozygous per the paper, not compound heterozygous. Variant strings are protein-only; no cDNA or transcript printed.
